decision_summary: Implement v0.6.28 as a narrow Evaluation Suite Health release in the calibration package.
rationale: Visionary: evaluation validity must become a governed object before confidence can be calibrated. Builder: add one record family to world-model-calibration, link calibration runs, and evaluate eight explicit dimensions deterministically. Guardian: complete metadata is not semantic validity; provisional, degraded, blocked, example, or stale records must not satisfy empirical readiness, and activity counts remain evidence signals only.
recommendation: Proceed with schema, verifier, fixtures, example, calibration-readiness regression, authoring guidance, roadmap, and release evidence; defer trial variance and framework learning.
